visualStyleNotes: Geometry, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A garden bed with corner fence posts, a small walker figure, and a running distance tape. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Garden bed: warm paper panel (roughness ~0.5). Fence posts: small warm-grey posts at the corners. Walker: small rounded warm warm figure. Distance tape: thin warm paper strip with ink ticks extending along the outline. Counter plate: warm paper with a live total. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: perimeter as the walk around a shape — a rectangular garden bed with fence posts, a walker figure that circles the edge, a running distance tape, and a live total counter; a triangle preset.

GEOMETRY: A flat rectangular bed on a board with fence posts at its corners. A small walker figure sits on the outline; 'auto-walk' moves it around the perimeter while a distance tape extends along the edges and a counter climbs to the total. Dragging a corner resizes the bed and resets the walk. A 'triangle bed' preset swaps to three posts, sum three sides.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) board; (2) garden bed; (3) fence posts; (4) walker + distance tape + counter.

CAMERA: high three-quarter above the board, frames the bed and walker; labels legible. Budget 5-9k triangles. Named nodes: Board, GardenBed, FencePosts, Walker, DistanceTape, CounterTag, TrianglePreset. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
